new_today_news.headline: Openings & Closings: Eataly Caffè; Adobo Mexican Grill/Taco Tek; Dunkin; Blu Cafe
new_today_news.summary: New York City restaurant openings and rebranding activities including Eataly Caffè, Taco Tek (formerly Adobo Mexican Grill), and multiple Dunkin locations across the Upper West Side.

new_today_news.headline: China expands waste oil processing for sustainable aviation fuel production
new_today_news.summary: A new plant in China will process up to 320,000 tons of used cooking oil and other bio-based feedstocks annually to produce SAF using HEFA technology and Haldor Topsoe's hydroisomerization process, expected to yield 800 kg of SAF per ton of pretreated waste oil.

new_today_news.headline: Golden Corral is closing more restaurants than usual this year
new_today_news.summary: Golden Corral confirmed closure of multiple buffet chain locations in 2026, with at least seven shuttered sites. The company indicated several closed locations will reopen under new franchisee ownership.

new_today_news.headline: Kolekt launches waste simulator for government use
new_today_news.summary: Kolekt has launched a waste simulator tool designed for government use. The tool appears to be part of broader innovation in the waste industry.

recent_news.headline: Five of Montgomery County's Hottest Recent Restaurant Openings (October 2026 Edition)
recent_news.summary: Montgomery County, Maryland saw notable restaurant openings including Guapo's GO fast-casual concept, ZiZa Kabob halal restaurant, and other concepts in recent months, generating strong community interest.

recent_news.headline: 5 best new restaurant openings and dining updates in Boston (October 16, 2026)
recent_news.summary: Boston-area restaurant openings including EnYa Robatayaki & Sake Bar, Michette Bakery expansion, and The Sports Bra bar concept planned for the Financial District.

recent_news.headline: Total restaurant industry sales
recent_news.summary: Latest NRA economic data shows positive sales trajectory despite headwinds including elevated gas prices and labor market softening. Real restaurant sales rose for sixth consecutive month in September 2026.

recent_news.headline: Barrel Energy's Happy Traps Launches Eco-Friendly Cleaners Line
recent_news.summary: Barrel Energy, through its Happy Traps business in waste collection and recycling focused on used cooking oil and grease-trap waste, is extending activities beyond collection by converting recovered by-products into commercial cleaners and degreasers.

recent_news.headline: Notice of Lodging of Proposed Fourth Amended Consent Decree Under the Clean Water Act - City of Akron
recent_news.summary: Department of Justice lodged a Fourth Amendment to the Consent Decree for Akron's municipal wastewater treatment facility and sewer system, addressing combined sewer overflows and treatment bypasses under a comprehensive Long Term Control Plan Update.

backfill_news.headline: Grease Waste Requirements are Now Effective
backfill_news.summary: Florida's grease waste program update ensures that fats, oils, and grease from restaurant kitchens are handled safely and responsibly through licensed haulers and self-cleaners. The program addresses proper disposal to prevent environmental damage and clogged pipes.
